questions.text:
The velocity v (in kilometer/minute) of a motorbike which starts from rest, is given at fixed intervals of time t (in minutes) as follows:

The approximate distance (in kilometers) rounded to two places of decimals covered in 20 minutes using Simpson's [latex]1/3^{rd}[/latex] rule is _______________.
questions.solution:
The bike starts from rest, so v = 0 at t = 0. With h = 2 we have 11 points:
v = 0, 10, 18, 25, 29, 32, 20, 11, 5, 2, 0

- Odd positions: 10 + 25 + 32 + 11 + 2 = 80
- Even (inner) positions: 18 + 29 + 20 + 5 = 72

[latex]D=\frac{h}{3}[v_0+v_{10}+4(80)+2(72)]=\frac23(0+0+320+144)=309.33[/latex]

Answer: 309.33

questions.text: Assume that a mergesort algorithm in the worst case takes 30 seconds for an input of size 64. Which of the following most closely approximates the maximum input size of a problem that can be solved in 6 minutes?
questions.solution:
Mergesort time [latex]\propto n\log n[/latex]. For n = 64: 64 [latex]\times[/latex] 6 = 384 units in 30 s.

6 minutes = 12 [latex]\times[/latex] 30 s [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 12 [latex]\times[/latex] 384 = 4608 units.

n = 512: 512 [latex]\times[/latex] 9 = 4608 [latex]\checkmark[/latex]

Answer: 512

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow

Let C(n) = number of calls made by get(n). C(n) = 1 for n [latex]\lt[/latex] 1, else C(n) = 1 + C(n[latex]-[/latex]1) + C(n[latex]-[/latex]3).

- C(1) = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3
- C(2) = 1 + 3 + 1 = 5
- C(3) = 1 + 5 + 1 = 7
- C(4) = 1 + 7 + 3 = 11
- C(5) = 1 + 11 + 5 = 17
- C(6) = 1 + 17 + 7 = 25

Answer: 25

questions.text: Consider a B+ tree in which the search key is 12 bytes long, block size is 1024 bytes, record pointer is 10 bytes long and block pointer is 8 bytes long. The maximum number of keys that can be accommodated in each non-leaf node of the tree is ____________.
questions.solution:
A non-leaf node with n block pointers holds n [latex]-[/latex] 1 keys:

[latex]8n+12(n-1)\le1024\Rightarrow20n\le1036\Rightarrow n=51[/latex]

Keys = 51 [latex]-[/latex] 1 = 50

Answer: 50

questions.text:
Given the function F=P'+QR , where F is a function in three Boolean variables P,Q and R and P'=!P, consider the following statements.
(S1) F=[latex]\Sigma[/latex](4,5,6)
(S2) F=[latex]\Sigma[/latex](0,1,2,3,7)
(S3) F=[latex]\Pi[/latex](4,5,6)
(S4) F=[latex]\Pi[/latex](0,1,2,3,7)
Which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
F = P' + QR is 1 for P = 0 (minterms 0, 1, 2, 3) and for P = Q = R = 1 (minterm 7).

- [latex]F=\Sigma(0,1,2,3,7)[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] S2 True, S1 False
- Maxterms are the rest: [latex]F=\Pi(4,5,6)[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] S3 True, S4 False

Answer: (S1) False, (S2) True, (S3) True, (S4) False
